author: Audspect
detection:
title: Suspicious PowerShell Encoded Command
id: 12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789012
status: stable
description: Detects encoded PowerShell command execution
author: Audspect
references:
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1059/001/
tags:
    - attack.execution
    - attack.t1059.001
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\powershell.exe'
        CommandLine|contains: '-EncodedCommand'
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate admin scripts using encoded commands
level: medium
falsePositives: Legitimate admin scripts using encoded commands
title: Suspicious PowerShell Encoded Command

translations.dataSource: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (Defender XDR) device events connected to Sentinel: the DeviceProcessEvents table
translations.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FolderPath endswith "\\powershell.exe" and ProcessCommandLine contains "-EncodedCommand"

translations.dataSource: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint advanced hunting: the DeviceProcessEvents table
translations.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FolderPath endswith "\\powershell.exe" and ProcessCommandLine contains "-EncodedCommand"

translations.dataSource: Sysmon event 1 (process creation) indexed by Splunk through the Splunk Add-on for Sysmon (source XmlWinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational)
Windows process events in ECS field names (Elastic Defend, or Winlogbeat / Sysmon with the ECS ingest pipeline)
CrowdStrike Falcon Data Replicator ProcessRollup2 events from the Windows sensor, in LogScale

author: Audspect
description: Detects setspn.exe or PowerShell SPN enumeration commonly used before a Kerberoasting attack
detection:
title: Kerberoasting via SPN Enumeration Tooling
id: 87654321-4321-4321-4321-210987654321
status: stable
description: Detects setspn.exe or PowerShell SPN enumeration commonly used before a Kerberoasting attack
author: Audspect
references:
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1558/003/
tags:
    - attack.credential_access
    - attack.t1558.003
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection_setspn:
        Image|endswith: '\setspn.exe'
        CommandLine|contains: '-Q'
    selection_powershell:
        Image|endswith: '\powershell.exe'
        CommandLine|contains: 'GetUserSPNs'
    condition: selection_setspn or selection_powershell
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate AD administration and SPN auditing
level: medium
falsePositives: Legitimate AD administration and SPN auditing
title: Kerberoasting via SPN Enumeration Tooling

translations.dataSource: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (Defender XDR) device events connected to Sentinel: the DeviceProcessEvents table
translations.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where (FolderPath endswith "\\setspn.exe" and ProcessCommandLine contains "-Q") or (FolderPath endswith "\\powershell.exe" and ProcessCommandLine contains "GetUserSPNs")

translations.dataSource: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint advanced hunting: the DeviceProcessEvents table
translations.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where (FolderPath endswith "\\setspn.exe" and ProcessCommandLine contains "-Q") or (FolderPath endswith "\\powershell.exe" and ProcessCommandLine contains "GetUserSPNs")

translations.dataSource: Sysmon event 1 (process creation) indexed by Splunk through the Splunk Add-on for Sysmon (source XmlWinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational)
Windows process events in ECS field names (Elastic Defend, or Winlogbeat / Sysmon with the ECS ingest pipeline)
CrowdStrike Falcon Data Replicator ProcessRollup2 events from the Windows sensor, in LogScale
translations.query: event_platform=/^Win$/i event_simpleName=/^ProcessRollup2$/i or event_simpleName=/^SyntheticProcessRollup2$/i (ImageFileName=/\\setspn\.exe$/i CommandLine=/-Q/i) or (ImageFileName=/\\powershell\.exe$/i CommandLine=/GetUserSPNs/i)
